title: $100M Through U.S. Banks, Feds Say: Huawei's Skycom

lines.say: More than a hundred million dollars. That's what one bank cleared through the U.S. for a company called Skycom, the indictment says.
lines.show: More than $100 million. That's what one bank cleared through the U.S. for a company called Skycom, the indictment says.

lines.say: Skycom, the indictment says, was Huawei's unofficial subsidiary in Iran.

scene.src: Superseding Indictment S-4, U.S. v. Huawei (E.D.N.Y. 18-cr-457, Dkt. 689)

lines.say: The Justice Department says Huawei lied to banks to obtain billions of U.S. dollars.

scene.src: U.S. Dept. of Justice press release 26-1413, Nov 24, 2026

lines.say: On November twenty-fourth, a jury convicted Huawei of bank fraud, sanctions violations and money laundering.
lines.show: On November 24, a jury convicted Huawei of bank fraud, sanctions violations and money laundering.

lines.say: Would a bank believe a denial? Full case on the channel.
